decisions.reason: ACE3 was announced as a flagship that sets a new industry standard, sits at the core of the firm's established airfield lighting control business, and has had only one year on the market, so results are not yet judged against aspiration and no shortfall calls for problemistic search.

The air situation display complements the firm's airport surveillance and control portfolio, and with little evidence of underperformance after one year, organisational slack in a specialised niche firm lets it carry the still uncertain product rather than drop it.
